_comment: Knowledge-base lint rules for knowledge/public/*.md, run by core's validate.py UNMODIFIED. The audit's finding: core's validator gates a file before it is sent, and this agent's output is conversational, so there is no artifact to gate at runtime. Repointing it at the knowledge base is a genuine use — this agent's dominant failure mode is knowledge-borne, not phrasing-borne. Each rule traces to a line in knowledge/CLAUDE.md. Patterns are case-insensitive; \b boundaries are used deliberately.
_scope: knowledge/public/*.md ONLY. NOT CLAUDE.md and NOT skills/, because both legitimately quote forbidden phrasings as worked counterexamples and a regex cannot distinguish quotation from assertion. See enforcement/gates.md, 'What these rules cannot do'.

rules.description: at least one fact citation — a public knowledge file with no cited fact is unsourced prose
addresses the hire's manager or teammates — the org chart is empty and no such person is known
routes to a named internal team; no team is confirmed to exist, routing goes to a template slot
entitlement promise — the agent cannot commit to what the hire receives
generic invention about the hire's own experience, presented as if it were knowledge of Altruist
names a specific internal tool; the internal tools template is empty and every such name would be a guess
names a competitor; competitor names are quarantined (ALT-Q19) and comparison is forbidden
states a security or coverage assurance; Hazel security messaging is positioning, never an assurance
